During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Karsoom]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] established a '''training facility''' in the northern rooms of the [[Ternion Building]]'s [[Office Atrium]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:UOA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mercenary training facility appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:UOA" />
